name: Mountain Den
summary: Mountain Den is an isolated, hollow cave tucked into the craggy hills northeast of South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh. Uninhabited by beasts or travelers, the cavern sits quietly off the beaten track with no evident purpose or inhabitants.

sections.title: A Quiet Refuge in the Snow
sections.body: Tucked away in the frigid ridges above South Gate Outpost, the Mountain Den is an unremarkable, sheltered cave carved directly into the rock face. Unlike the trogg-infested tunnels or bear dens dotting Dun Morogh, this hollow cavern remains completely vacant. There are no supplies, campfires, or hostile predators lurking inside, making it little more than a natural shelter from the biting mountain winds.

sections.title: A Strange Resemblance
sections.body: Well-traveled explorers who stumble into this cavern might find its contours eerily familiar. The cave shares an identical layout with remote hermitages found far across Azeroth, most notably Ortell's Hideout deep in the deserts of Silithus. A curious quirk of its isolated nature has led travelers to whisper strange tales of atmospheric anomalies echoing from far-off sands when stepping within its rocky threshold.

faq.q: Where is the Mountain Den located?
faq.answer: The Mountain Den is situated in the snowy hills northeast of South Gate Outpost in Dun Morogh, near the southern rim of the zone.

faq.q: Who lives in the Mountain Den?
faq.answer: No one lives here. The cave is completely devoid of NPCs, quest givers, and hostile creatures, standing as an empty natural hollow.

faq.q: Are there any quests associated with this cave?
faq.answer: No quests lead to or take place within the Mountain Den. It does not appear to serve any active role in local dwarven affairs.

faq.q: Why does the cave feel familiar to experienced adventurers?
faq.answer: The cavern's physical layout is identical to Ortell's Hideout, a remote cave located in the distant desert of Silithus on Kalimdor.

angles.text: For dwarves patrolling the high passes near South Gate Outpost, the cave offers an empty, windless vantage point away from the roving wolves and troggs.
